# Q4 2025 Physics Course Schedule

## Honors Physics & Standard Physics - 4 Week Schedule

| Week | Honors Physics (Advanced) | Standard Physics |
|------|---------------------------|------------------|
| 1    | **Unit 7: Waves and Harmonics**<br>- Wave-Particle Duality<br>- Photon Energy (E = hf)<br>- Wave Equation (λf = c)<br>- Photoelectric Effect<br>- Energy Quantization Concepts<br><br>**Lab:** Photoelectric Effect Simulation | **L1 - Safe Driving Statistics**<br>- Analysis of traffic collision data<br>- Pattern recognition in vehicle fatality data<br>- Collision modeling with paper strips<br>- Video analysis of real-world collisions<br><br>**L2 - Distracted Driving**<br>- P/T and V/T graphing<br>- Comparing motion graphs for distracted/non-distracted scenarios<br>- Analyzing reaction time data |
| 2    | **Unit 7: Waves and Harmonics**<br>- Electric Charges and Fields<br>- Coulomb's Law (F = k(q₁q₂)/r²)<br>- Electric Field Strength (E = F/q)<br>- Gauss's Law<br>- Electric Potential<br><br>**Lab:** Electric Field Mapping | **L3 - Speed and Collisions (avoidance)**<br>- V-T Graphing<br>- Reaction Distance (d = v × t)<br>- Braking Distance (d = v²/(2μg))<br>- Total Stopping Distance calculations<br>- Engineering faster reaction times (HUD, Cameras)<br><br>**L4 - Speed and Collision (outcomes)**<br>- Analyzing collision data<br>- Force-time relationships<br>- Newton's Second Law (F = ma)<br>- Introduction to impulse (J = F·Δt) |
| 3    | **Unit 7: Waves and Harmonics**<br>- Electromagnetic Power and Energy<br>- Electric Power (P = VI)<br>- Faraday's Law<br>- Energy in Electric Fields (UE = ½CV²)<br>- Energy in Magnetic Fields (UB = ½LI²)<br><br>**Lab:** Electromagnetic Induction | **L5 - Mass, Speed, Force**<br>- Kinetic Energy (KE = ½mv²)<br>- Momentum (p = mv)<br>- Elastic vs. inelastic collisions<br>- Coefficient of restitution<br>- Safety features analysis (crumple zones, airbags)<br><br>**L6 - Lab: Momentum and Impulse Carts**<br>- Experimental design<br>- Collecting collision data<br>- Calculating pre/post collision momentum<br>- Verifying conservation principles |
| 4    | **Unit 9: Electricity**<br>- Electrostatics<br>- Capacitance (C = Q/V)<br>- Electric Field (E = F/q)<br>- Potential Difference (V = W/q)<br>- Capacitor Energy (U = ½CV²)<br><br>**Lab:** Capacitor Charging/Discharging | **L7 - Assessment: Vehicle Stopping Times**<br>- Comprehensive problem solving<br>- Multi-step collision scenarios<br>- Engineering design challenge<br>- Bus safety data analysis<br>- Evidence-based safety solutions<br><br>**Review:**<br>- Force (F = ma)<br>- Momentum (p = mv)<br>- Impulse (J = FΔt = Δp)<br>- Kinetic Energy (KE = ½mv²) |
